claim_statement: Typed hierarchical parameter schemas strictly enforce gene-to-phenotype validity across tree/mlp/linear/kernel model families
limitations_and_scope: Supported families are bounded to 4 classical tabular families; unsupported hyperparameters (e.g. dropout in linear) are rejected at instantiation.

claim_statement: TPEStrategy records evaluated outcomes in observation_history and proposal distributions adapt based on observed feedback
limitations_and_scope: Uses 1D factorized/univariate Gaussian KDE for continuous parameters and Laplace-smoothed categorical Parzen models; does not model complex joint multi-dimensional covariances.

claim_statement: Strict training fold isolation: preprocessors fit strictly on train split before transforming validation split
limitations_and_scope: In-process Python execution shares memory unless isolated=True (multiprocessing spawn) is explicitly activated.

claim_statement: Out-of-process evaluation workers enforce hard deadline termination and sample resident set size (RSS)
limitations_and_scope: Subprocess termination uses SIGKILL / TerminateProcess; memory telemetry reports process-level RSS rather than cgroup hardware limits.

claim_statement: Append-only SQLite ledger guarantees transactional durability and tamper-evident SHA-256 state chaining
limitations_and_scope: Provides local tamper-evidence via hash-chain recalculation (verify_chain); does not provide external blockchain anchoring or asymmetric digital signatures.

claim_statement: Unconstrained archive (capacity=None) preserves exact non-dominated frontier without approximation
limitations_and_scope: When bounded capacity is configured (capacity=K) NSGA-II crowding distance pruning with extreme point retention is used; unbounded archive memory grows with non-dominated candidate count.

claim_statement: Sealed challenge partition enforces a single-use authorization token gate accessible only at finalization
limitations_and_scope: Represents an in-process cryptographic access gate rather than hardware enclave / OS sandbox isolation; intentional introspection of Python objects could bypass memory boundaries.

claim_statement: AMDE 4.0 demonstrates comparable accuracy to Random Search and Bayesian TPE on synthetic/tabular tasks
limitations_and_scope: Evaluated across 18 task-seed pairs (6 datasets x 3 seeds); two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests show Holm-Bonferroni adjusted p >= 0.67; no statistically significant superiority detected.

claim_statement: Guardian process automatically detects crashed manager processes and restarts them while preserving campaign state
limitations_and_scope: State persistence depends on local filesystem atomic replaces; subject to OS-specific file sharing semantics (hardened via read_json_safe retries).

claim_statement: Full test suite passes on both Ubuntu Linux (24.04) and Windows (Server 2022) across Python 3.10 and 3.14
limitations_and_scope: Python 3.14 is currently pre-release/alpha upstream; tested to ensure future-facing compatibility but production deployment targets Python 3.10+.
